title: Bookshelf and source entry expose implementation-progress copy
symptom: The empty bookshelf displayed copy such as "当前版本已经打通文件复制、解析、入书架和基础阅读页。", and the online source entry displayed "书源能力已预留，首期暂不接入真实网络源。". These are implementation-status notes rather than user-facing product states.
root_cause: BookshelfScreen and SourceEntryScreen used early development placeholder copy directly in visible Composables, so internal progress/status wording leaked into normal app UI.
fix: Replace the empty bookshelf implementation-progress note with a concise empty state: no imported books yet, import local TXT to continue reading.
Rename the bookshelf online-source action and source top bar from "在线书源入口" to "在线书源".
Replace the source placeholder with a clear unavailable state and local TXT fallback guidance.
Add an instrumented Compose copy regression that renders both entry surfaces and asserts the old implementation-progress phrases are not visible.
failed_attempts: Manual screenshot inspection surfaced the issue, but static screenshots alone do not protect against copy regressions; visible copy needs a Compose text assertion.
impact: Keeps first-run and unavailable-feature screens user-facing and avoids exposing internal implementation progress in normal visual flows.
